$comment: Quality and cost are tracked together on purpose. An agent that answers
better by taking three times as many steps is usually not an improvement,
and KPIs that omit step count let that trade happen unnoticed.

kpis.name: graph_health
kpis.description: Offline structural checks passing: graph, tools, scenarios, termination. Free to measure.

kpis.name: eval_pass_rate
kpis.description: Live-model case pass rate from the last `make evaluate`. Daily, because it costs tokens.

kpis.name: tool_precision
kpis.description: Expected tool calls over actual. Falls when the agent flails, which a pass rate alone hides.

kpis.name: avg_steps
kpis.description: Mean graph steps per case — the closest cheap proxy for cost per run

kpis.name: recursion_aborts
kpis.description: Runs that hit the recursion limit. Non-zero means the agent is looping in production.
